titleEn: Students who attended Miami-Dade public school pre-K outperformed peers in 18-year study
titleZh: 十八年追踪研究：参加公立学前教育的学生表现更好
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Choosing a preschool is a difficult and important decision. Parents are weighing cost, proximity and convenience with how each program meets the needs of the child and matches the goals and values of their family and cultural community.
paragraphs.zh: 选择幼儿园是一个艰难而重要的决定。家长们在权衡成本、距离和便利性，以及每个项目如何满足孩子的需求，并与家庭和文化社区的目标和价值观相匹配。

paragraphs.en: This choice makes a difference. Research in early education clearly shows that children who attend high-quality preschool programs – those with smaller class sizes, a developmentally appropriate curriculum, warm teacher-child interactions and established, efficient routines – are better prepared for kindergarten.
paragraphs.zh: 这一选择会带来不同。早期教育研究清楚地表明，参加高质量学前教育项目的儿童--那些班级规模较小、适合发展的课程、温暖的师生互动以及既定的高效常规--对幼儿园的准备更充分。

paragraphs.en: We are researchers who study early childhood education, and we conducted an 18-year study tracking the academic progress of 27,814 students who attended different types of prekindergarten in Miami and then went on to attend the Miami-Dade County Public Schools system from kindergarten through high school. We found that the type of pre-K program the children attended made a difference for their overall educational outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们是研究幼儿教育的研究人员，我们进行了一项为期18年的研究，跟踪了27,814名学生的学业进展，这些学生在迈阿密上过不同类型的学前班，然后从幼儿园到高中就读于迈阿密-戴德县公立学校系统。我们发现，孩子们上的学前班的类型对他们的整体教育成果有影响。

paragraphs.en: How we did our study
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何进行研究

paragraphs.en: From 2002 to 2007, we partnered with Miami-Dade County Public Schools, early childcare providers across the county and the Early Learning Coalition of Miami-Dade, a nonprofit that works with childcare providers and communities to promote school readiness, with the goal of assessing five cohorts of about 10,000 students per year.
paragraphs.zh: 从2002年到2007年，我们与迈阿密-戴德县公立学校，全县的幼儿保育提供者和迈阿密-戴德早期学习联盟合作，这是一个与儿童保育提供者和社区合作促进入学准备的非营利组织，目标是每年评估约10，000名学生的五个队列。

paragraphs.en: School readiness takes into consideration the children’s cognitive, language, motor and social skills, as well as behavior problems. During the study, we shared the data we collected with parents, teachers and center directors to inform interventions for struggling kids and improvements to their pre-K programs.
paragraphs.zh: 入学准备考虑到孩子们的认知，语言，运动和社交技能，以及行为问题。在研究期间，我们与家长，教师和中心主任分享了我们收集的数据，为困难儿童提供干预措施，并改善他们的学前教育计划。

paragraphs.en: Some of the students in these five cohorts attended taxpayer-funded, public school pre-K programs, while some received federal subsidies administered through the state of Florida to attend center-based or family childcare at age 4.
paragraphs.zh: 这五个队列中的一些学生参加了纳税人资助的公立学校学前教育项目，而另一些学生则在4岁时获得了通过佛罗里达州管理的联邦补贴，以参加以中心为基础的或家庭儿童保育。

paragraphs.en: Center-based programs, like a Kiddie Academy, for example, can be nonprofit or for-profit centers in the community. They operate either in a freestanding location or as part of a corporate or faith-based building. Family or home-based childcare programs are generally smaller and operate out of private residences.
paragraphs.zh: 以中心为基础的项目，比如儿童学院，可以是社区中的非营利性或营利性中心。它们可以在独立的地点运营，也可以作为公司或宗教建筑的一部分。家庭或家庭为基础的儿童保育项目通常规模较小，在私人住宅外运营。

paragraphs.en: After the children had moved through pre-K, we continued to receive their anonymized academic records each year, as long as they stayed in the public school system. The last cohort of students completed 12th grade in spring 2020.
paragraphs.zh: 在孩子们完成学前教育后，我们每年都会继续收到他们的匿名学习记录，只要他们留在公立学校系统。最后一批学生在2020年春季完成了12年级。

paragraphs.en: Outcomes in later grades
paragraphs.zh: 以后各年级的成绩

paragraphs.en: We found that children who attended public school pre-K programs at age 4 achieved the strongest third-grade outcomes on standardized reading and math test scores and GPA. These children outperformed those who attended center-based care, who in turn generally performed better than children who were enrolled in family childcare. Kids who attended public school pre-K were 35% less likely to be held back in third grade compared with the other groups.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，在4岁时参加公立学校学前教育项目的孩子在标准化阅读和数学考试成绩以及GPA方面取得了最好的三年级成绩。这些孩子的表现优于那些参加中心护理的孩子，而这些孩子的表现通常比参加家庭托儿服务的孩子好。参加公立学校学前班的孩子有35%与其他组相比，他们在三年级时被留级的可能性更小。

paragraphs.en: Further, we found that kids who attended higher-quality elementary schools – as measured by the Florida Department of Education – did better on average.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们还发现，在佛罗里达教育部衡量的高质量小学上学的孩子平均成绩更好。

paragraphs.en: However, the quality of the elementary school that students went on to attend didn’t change the differences we observed across the early childhood education types, except when it came to reading skills. Students who attended center-based care and went on to attend higher-quality schools were better able to catch up to the public school pre-K kids by third grade in reading.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，除了阅读技能之外，学生们继续就读的小学的质量并没有改变我们在幼儿教育类型中观察到的差异。参加中心护理并继续就读更高质量学校的学生在阅读方面能够更好地赶上公立学校学前班的孩子。

paragraphs.en: Our findings are consistent with most previous studies of public pre-K. Students who attended public pre-K programs in Boston; Tulsa, Oklahoma; and North Carolina have shown better results on standardized test scores, lower absenteeism and better grade retention when compared with children who attended other programs, even as late as eighth grade.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果与大多数以前的公共学前班的研究是一致的。在波士顿、塔尔萨、俄克拉荷马州和北卡罗来纳州参加公共学前班的学生，与参加其他项目的学生相比，即使晚到八年级，在标准化考试成绩、缺勤率和成绩保持率方面也表现出了更好的成绩。

paragraphs.en: However, there are outliers. Children who attended the publicly funded voluntary pre-K program in Tennessee did not perform any better than other children on third or sixth grade outcomes – and in some cases, they performed worse.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，也有例外。在田纳西州，参加公共资助的自愿学前教育项目的儿童在三年级或六年级的成绩上并不比其他儿童好--在某些情况下，他们的成绩更差。

paragraphs.en: Previous findings are also mixed on whether these effects persist past the third grade.
paragraphs.zh: 以前的研究结果也混合了这些影响是否持续到三年级之后。

paragraphs.en: In our study, it appears that the long-term benefits of public school pre-K extend through eighth grade, but this conclusion is still in peer review and has not been published yet. We are currently examining whether benefits persist throughout high school.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的研究中，公立学校学前教育的长期益处似乎延伸到八年级，但这一结论仍在同行评议中，尚未发表。我们目前正在研究这些益处是否会持续到整个高中。

paragraphs.en: Collective resources
paragraphs.zh: 集体资源

paragraphs.en: Why did kids in public school pre-K programs do better compared to center-based and family childcare? We believe that the answer likely lies in the quality and organizational differences between the three different types of early care and education.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么公立学校学前教育项目的孩子比中心和家庭儿童保育项目的孩子做得更好？我们认为，答案可能在于三种不同类型的早期护理和教育之间的质量和组织差异。

paragraphs.en: The public school pre-K programs in our study benefited from the collective resources of the fourth-largest public school system in the country. This matters for everything from the quality of teachers they are able to hire to the facilities and curriculum.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究中的公立学校学前教育项目受益于美国第四大公立学校系统的集体资源，这对他们能够雇用的教师质量、设施和课程都很重要。

paragraphs.en: Miami-Dade public schools require teachers to have at minimum a bachelor’s degree and a teaching credential, whereas the others required less education at the time of our study. Public pre-K teachers’ certification allows them to teach from pre-K to third grade, so they typically bring their experience of teaching in kindergarten and the early elementary grades to the pre-K classroom.
paragraphs.zh: 迈阿密-戴德公立学校要求教师至少拥有学士学位和教学证书，而在我们研究的时候，其他公立学校要求的教育程度较低。公立幼儿园教师的证书允许他们从幼儿园到三年级任教，所以他们通常会把他们在幼儿园和小学早期的教学经验带到幼儿园教室。

paragraphs.en: These programs also used a developmentally appropriate curriculum, while the others used a variety of materials and approaches. When we began this study, the center-based programs were mostly independent, unaffiliated sites, although some for-profits had more than one center in the study, and some nonprofit organizations such as Catholic Charities or the YMCA oversaw multiple centers.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们开始这项研究时，以中心为基础的项目大多是独立的，无关联的网站，尽管一些营利性组织在研究中有一个以上的中心，一些非营利组织，如天主教慈善机构或基督教青年会监督多个中心。

paragraphs.en: Many of the children in the study moved from one school to another within the same district. Because Miami-Dade’s public schools are part of a countywide system, the children’s academic records moved with them easily, so their new teacher could see their progress. And since the curriculum was the same across the district, the students were able to pick up at their new school where they’d left off.
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究中的许多孩子都是在同一个地区从一所学校转到另一所学校的。因为迈阿密-戴德的公立学校是一个县系统的一部分，孩子们的学习成绩很容易随他们一起移动，所以他们的新老师可以看到他们的进步。而且因为整个地区的课程都是一样的，学生们可以在他们离开的新学校继续学习。

paragraphs.en: This continuity could also explain why children who entered the public school system in pre-K performed better than those outside it. The majority of the children in the study went on to attend public elementary school. The kids in public school preschool and their parents were therefore already familiar with the schools that they would be attending the following year. It’s not hard to see how this would be an advantage for a child transitioning from preschool to kindergarten.
paragraphs.zh: 这种连续性也可以解释为什么在学龄前进入公立学校系统的儿童，K的表现比其他学校的孩子好。研究中的大多数孩子都上了公立小学。因此，公立学前班的孩子和他们的父母已经熟悉了他们下一年要上的学校。不难看出这对孩子来说是一个优势从学前班到幼儿园的过渡。

paragraphs.en: Better than ever
paragraphs.zh: 比以往任何时候都好

paragraphs.en: Our findings do not indicate to us, however, that every child must attend public school pre-K in order to succeed in school later on. The reality in Miami-Dade County – and in most communities – is that we need all forms of early care and education, and each setting serves important needs for families.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，我们的研究结果并不意味着每个孩子都必须上学前公立学校才能在以后的学校取得成功。迈阿密-戴德县和大多数社区的现实是，我们需要各种形式的早期护理和教育，每种环境都能满足家庭的重要需求。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, students in all three types of programs made excellent school readiness gains from the beginning to the end of the age-4 academic year. It was just that the children in the public school preschools made stronger gains.
paragraphs.zh: 事实上，从4岁学年开始到结束，参加这三种项目的学生都有很好的入学准备，只是公立幼儿园的孩子进步更大。

paragraphs.en: Center- and home-based care in Miami-Dade County is much higher quality across the board today than when we began our study back in 2002. Many more centers are accredited, and teacher education levels have improved. In fact, in our assessment, the quality of early education in Miami-Dade County has never been better.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们2002年开始研究时相比，如今迈阿密-戴德县的中心和家庭护理质量全面提高。更多的中心获得了认证，教师教育水平也得到了提高。事实上，根据我们的评估，迈阿密-戴德县的早期教育质量从未如此之好。

paragraphs.en: Still, the cohesive system offered by public schools remains the gold standard for preschool when serving most children and families. In terms of teacher preparation and qualifications, standardized curriculum, oversight and alignment with the kindergarten curriculum, public school pre-k for low-income families in Miami still offers the best hope of long-term academic success.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，公立学校提供的有凝聚力的体系仍然是学前教育的黄金标准，为大多数儿童和家庭提供服务。就教师准备和资格、标准化课程、监督以及与幼儿园课程的一致性而言，迈阿密面向低收入家庭的公立学前教育仍然是获得长期学业成功的最大希望。
